title: Oikonomou2016 – SSVEP MAMEM 2 dataset
description: A 256-channel EEG dataset from 11 healthy subjects performing a steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. Subjects focused attention on flickering visual stimuli at five different frequencies (6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00, and 12.00 Hz) to select commands. The dataset includes 1,104 trials acquired at 250 Hz using an EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System and was used to systematically evaluate state-of-the-art signal processing and classification algorithms for SSVEP-based BCIs.
methods_description: EEG signals were recorded from 11 healthy subjects (8 male, 3 female; age 24-39 years) using a 256-channel EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System (GSN-HydroCel-256 montage) at 250 Hz sampling rate with Cz reference. Subjects performed a visual attention task focusing on flickering boxes presented at five simultaneous frequencies. Each trial consisted of 5 seconds of visual stimulation followed by 5 seconds of rest. Data were acquired in raw format without preprocessing. Leave-one-subject-out cross-validation was employed for algorithm evaluation.
